planets.name: Kepler-10 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-10 with a 0.837-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-10 b was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-10. Its orbit and size follow Dumusque et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: Kepler-10b
quotes.card: Kepler-10b is the first confirmed terrestrial planet to have been discovered outside the Solar System by the Kepler Space Telescope.
quotes.introduction: Discovered after several months of data collection during the course of the NASA-directed Kepler Mission, which aims to discover Earth-like planets crossing in front of their host stars, the planet's discovery was announced on January 10, 2011.
